cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide horizontal separation between the ears, roughly equivalent to the width of the forehead.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Uniformly rounded semicircular curvature at the top boundary of both ears.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced brownish-yellow fur staining is visible across the ventral abdominal and lower thoracic regions.
